newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SUBSTITUTE VAN VOSSEN SCORES TWICE IN RANGERS' CUP WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUBSTITUTE VAN VOSSEN SCORES TWICE IN RANGERS' CUP WIN.

text.p: Substitute Peter Van Vossen scored twice in the second half to help Rangers to a crushing 4-0 Scottish League Cup quarter-final victory over Hibernian on Wednesday.
Dutchman Van Vossen, who replaced the injured Ally McCoist in the 36th minute, scored a fine solo goal, Rangers' second, two minutes after the break.
Former Hibs player Gordon Durie had given the Glasgow club the lead in the 29th minute after being set up by Paul Gascoigne.
Van Vossen's second -- his seventh of the season -- came from close range 10 minutes from time and German Jorg Albertz completed the rout with an explosive 30-metre free kick.
Albertz's goal came after Hibs's Darren Jackson had blazed an 87th minute penalty over the bar.
